purpose: Exploratory desktop model-only timing of all fixed widths and the original control
checkpoints: Untrained candidate checkpoints and original source checkpoint; timing tests architecture, not fine-tuning weights.
runtime: PyTorch FP32, RTX 3060 Laptop GPU, batch 1, preallocated zero tensor
limitations: One forward and one reverse ordering; uncontrolled power and temperature; not TensorRT, Orin or end-to-end timing.
